applies_to: every row in this file (20 rows, GHA run 25539291483, commit 4e861b3)
retraction_reason: Measured on the 52-byte fallback corpus, not on a dataset. At commit 4e861b3 src/bin/cpu_train.rs::load_data read the hardcoded path data/tinyshakespeare.txt and, on failure, substituted the 52-byte literal "Hello world this is a tiny training dataset for IGLA". /data/ was gitignored and .github/workflows/format-algo-matrix.yml had no step that fetched or created any corpus, so every cell in run 25539291483 trained and evaluated on those 52 bytes. With --vocab=128 an untrained model scores log2(128) = 7.0 bpb exactly, which is what these rows report. This row is NOT a measurement of any model, format or optimizer and must not be cited, averaged or plotted.
caveats: seed_phi cannot be trusted: the writer repainted forbidden seeds 42/43/44/45 into 47/89/144/123 and emitted only the result, so seed_phi=47 here may be a rewritten 42. The repaint is deleted as of 2026-08-03 and the column is now `seed`.
loss_final carries no independent information: it is bpb*ln(2), verified byte-identical on all 20 rows.
wallclock_ms=0 on all 20 rows: the writer hardcoded the constant; the column is removed.
falsifier_2_hit=true on all 20 rows means the corpus was absent, not that Gate-2 was refuted by a real run.
bpb here is cpu_train's `final_bpb`, which at this commit was the running MINIMUM over evals, not the value at step == steps.
note: The rows below are preserved verbatim as evidence of what was published. They are retained, not deleted: a vanished witness ledger is worse than a marked one. Re-running the matrix against a named, hash-pinned corpus is the only way to replace them.
